title: Agencia de investimento brasileira leva delegacao recorde a Web Summit Lisboa (Forbes Portugal with Lusa, 7 November 2023)
what_it_says: Forbes Portugal, with Lusa, reports ApexBrasil taking 85 startups and 100 companies to Web Summit 2023, a record, against 80 companies in 2022, the year of the first Brazil Pavilion.
